description: Harness launch vectors, v1: per kind, the launch inputs Waycar takes (Chat Mode prompt/model/Quick thinking, first message, the user's Arguments, a resume and its session, the Backend) and exactly what the app's builders (LaunchPromptStager.plan + LaunchPromptPlan.command, ChatModeLaunch, ClosedSession.resumeArguments) ask for: the argv herdr's agent.start types / tmux runs (executable first; tmux also inserts --no-daemon after `codex` when the Host's codex lists it), the pane environment, and the staged files. Placeholders: {stage} = the Launch Prompt stage directory, {codexHome} = the Codex home, {home} = the Host's $HOME, {defaultChatPrompt} = ChatModePrompt.defaultText. sessionPin is the id a fresh launch pins, Chat Mode or not (fixed here); codex profiles are named waycar-22222222-3333-4444-8555-666666666666. `wire`, when present, is what the lab mock (/_log) logged for that launch, live-verified; absent fields are not asserted.
